_note:
Debugging tasks. Separate from the capability target on purpose: the break is applied to the working tree after reset, so these tasks cannot share a file with tasks that assume a clean checkout. Same repo and ref as frontend-familie-tilbake.

What this measures is fault localisation when a failing test already points at the behaviour. Reproduction, the hard part of real debugging, is not measured. Say so in any write-up.

Three guards, without the first of which this measures nothing:
1. A sample whose diff touches a test file fails. The cheap way to go green is to weaken the assertion, and a model that does it has not debugged anything.
2. The break is uncommitted working-tree state. A broken commit is discoverable with git log, and reverting it measures git skill rather than reading code.
3. One break is distant from its symptom: it is in stores/, and the tests that fail are two directories away in komponenter/sidebar/.
